representation: A smooth ellipsoid at the dimensions measured from Galileo images: 1.6 × 1.4 × 1.2 km. Craters and surface imagery are not represented; the grid marks missing imagery.
radiusMeaning: Volume-equivalent radius of the declared smooth envelope
citations: Galileo dimensions, shape and surface observations
Long-term orbit stability and candidate solutions
limitations: Approximate orbital placement. The 1993 encounter did not determine a unique orbit; the present orbital phase is illustrative. A synchronous orientation is assumed, not measured.

sourceSelection.missionImages: Encounter images establish resolved shape, but a camera-controlled texture is not yet qualified.
sourceSelection.celestia: Generic Dactyl texture and unregistered Selam reconstruction excluded.
sourceSelection.imagery: Shared missing-imagery grid. No stock rock texture, inferred albedo, or invented terrain.
